models.$description: Map of model_id → model-specific settings. Unknown models fall back to 'defaults'.
models.input: Modalities the model can receive. Valid: 'text', 'image', 'audio', 'video'. Controls which media types extendedRead returns. If 'audio' is absent, audio files return a note instead of media.

maxBytes.$description: Per-modality size caps (bytes). Larger files return a note.

defaults.$description: Fallback for models not listed in 'models'.
